customsDuty.title: Overseas Purchase Duty Calculator
customsDuty.subtitle: Check Korea's duty-free limit ($200 from the US, $150 elsewhere) and estimate customs duty, VAT and your total cost in KRW. As of October 2026.

origin.label: Shipped from
origin.hint: Based on where the parcel ships from. A US forwarding address counts as the USA.

hint.clothes: Clothing, underwear and socks carry a 13% basic duty rate. Accessories like hats and gloves are 8%, so use a custom rate.
hint.shoes: Shoes carry a 13% basic duty rate.
hint.bag: Regular bags and wallets are 8%. If one item exceeds KRW 2M, pick 'Luxury bag/watch'.
hint.cosmetics: Regular cosmetics are 8%. Functional cosmetics (sunscreen, whitening, anti-wrinkle) can't use list clearance, so switch to formal import declaration.
hint.perfume: Perfume carries 8% duty. The individual consumption tax on perfume has been abolished.
hint.watch: Regular watches are 8%. If one item exceeds KRW 2M, pick 'Luxury bag/watch'.
hint.luxury: If customs value plus duty exceeds KRW 2M per item, the excess also gets a 20% individual consumption tax plus education tax (30% of that tax). Calculated per item.
hint.it: 0% duty under the WTO Information Technology Agreement, so you pay only 10% VAT. Electronics brought in under the personal-use radio certification exemption (1 unit) can't use list clearance, so the limit is $150 even from the US.
hint.supplement: Supplements are excluded from list clearance, so the limit is $150 even from the US. Up to 6 bottles in total count as personal use.
hint.sports: Balls, rackets, golf clubs and similar equipment are 8%. Sportswear and sneakers use clothing/shoes (13%).
hint.furniture: Furniture, lighting and kitchenware are 8% per the Korea Customs Service estimator.
hint.book: Books carry 0% duty, so only VAT applies when taxed.
hint.custom: Look up the rate in the Korea Customs Service estimator or UNI-PASS tariff classification.

fta.label: Apply FTA rate (0% duty)
fta.hint: Goods made in the US or EU can get 0% duty with proof of origin (a purchase receipt works up to $1,000). It depends on where the item was made, not where you bought it.

hint.list: Clothing, shoes, bags and regular cosmetics clear with the courier's manifest only. Duty-free up to $200 from the US and $150 from elsewhere.
hint.general: Supplements, medicine, food, functional cosmetics and electronics (radio certification exemption, 1 unit) need an import declaration and are duty-free only up to $150, even from the US.

u.localHint: Money paid inside the shipping country, such as US sales tax or shipping from the store to your forwarder. It counts toward the duty-free limit.
u.shipHint: Shipping from abroad to Korea. It is excluded from the duty-free test when shown separately on your receipt, but included in the tax base once taxed.
u.other: Other order from the same seller on the same day (optional)
u.otherHint: Even if shipped separately, orders from the same seller on the same purchase date are added together (combined taxation). Enter its item price plus local costs.

rate.label: Exchange rate ({unit} = ? KRW)
rate.usdLabel: USD rate (1 USD = ? KRW, for the duty-free limit)
rate.usdHint: The duty-free limit is in US dollars, so your payment is converted to USD for the test.
rate.fallback: Korea Customs taxation rate checked on {date} (reference). It changes weekly.
rate.hint: Actual tax uses the Korea Customs Service taxation rate for the week of the import declaration (previous week's average, announced weekly), so it may differ slightly.

res.label: Estimated duty + VAT
res.remain: Assessed value ${goods} / limit ${limit} — you can spend ${remain} more duty-free.
res.remainFx: Assessed value ${goods} / limit ${limit} — you can spend ${remain} (about {fx} {cur}) more duty-free.
res.over: Assessed value ${goods} exceeds the ${limit} limit by ${over}. Tax applies to the whole amount including international shipping, not just the excess.

warn.combined: Combined taxation applies. This order alone is ${own}, within the limit, but together with the same-seller, same-day order it totals ${goods}, over the ${limit} limit, so both are taxed. The tax above covers both orders.
warn.ship: If international shipping isn't listed separately on your receipt, it may be added to the assessed value and push you over the ${limit} limit. Check that your receipt itemizes shipping.
warn.min: Reference: taxes under KRW 10,000 are not collected (Customs Act Art. 40). This calculator applies the threshold to each tax (duty, VAT) separately.
warn.usGeneral: Even from the US, the duty-free limit for import-declaration items is $150.
warn.luxury: The consumption tax is assessed per item. If you bought several, calculate them one at a time.

share.textExempt: My overseas order is ${goods}, within the ${limit} limit, so duty + VAT is 0 KRW
share.textTaxed: My overseas order is ${goods}, estimated duty + VAT {tax} KRW

limits.title: Duty-free limits at a glance
rows: From the US · list clearance items
formula: Assessed value = item price + local tax + domestic shipping (international shipping and insurance excluded when itemized)
At or under the limit, duty and VAT are both waived; one cent over and the whole amount is taxed
Customs value = (item price + international shipping) × customs taxation rate
Duty = customs value × duty rate, VAT = (customs value + duty) × 10%
Alcohol and tobacco are taxed even within the limit (liquor tax, tobacco tax) and are not covered here

u.disclaimer: This is an estimate. Actual tax depends on customs classification, valuation and the taxation rate. Confirm exact rates with the Korea Customs Service call center (125).

clearance.title: List clearance vs import declaration
items: List clearance: clothing, shoes, bags and regular cosmetics for personal use clear with the courier's manifest. No tax up to $200 from the US or $150 from elsewhere.

Import declaration: supplements, medicine, herbal medicine, food, functional cosmetics and electronics brought in under the personal-use radio certification exemption (1 unit) are excluded from list clearance. The limit is $150 even from the US.
The assessed value includes local taxes such as US sales tax and domestic shipping; international shipping to Korea is excluded when itemized on the receipt.
Up to 6 bottles of supplements in total count as personal use. More may require separate approval.

combined.title: How to avoid combined taxation
items: Items bought from the same overseas seller on the same day and imported separately, or one waybill (B/L, AWB) split into several clearances, are added together.
Since November 17, 2022, the 'same arrival date' rule no longer applies. Different sellers or purchase dates are assessed separately even if they arrive the same day.
So splitting an over-limit cart into several same-day payments to the same seller does not help.
Even with different purchase dates, customs can later collect tax if it judges the imports to be repeated, split or for resale.

refund.title: Do I get the tax back if I return it?
items: If a personal-use item with an accepted import declaration is returned abroad unused within 6 months, the duty you paid can be refunded (Customs Act Art. 106-2).
It must be exported via a bonded area or with customs confirmation, so ask customs (call 125) or your forwarder about the procedure before returning.
Keep the shipping proof and refund record, and ask about refunds of VAT and other taxes when you apply.
Items that entered duty-free have no tax to refund.

tips.title: Black Friday & Singles' Day checklist
items: Get a Personal Customs Clearance Code free on UNI-PASS. From 2026 it is valid for one year and must be renewed within 30 days before or after expiry.
Near the limit, recheck the price after coupons and the exchange rate. One cent over taxes the whole amount.
Using a forwarder in a state without sales tax (Delaware, Oregon, etc.) removes local tax from the assessed value.
Around Singles' Day (Nov 11) and Black Friday (Nov 27), volume surges and clearance may take longer than usual.
Your card statement may differ slightly from this calculator because of the card company's rate and overseas fees.

items.q: What is Korea's duty-free limit for overseas purchases?
items.a: Personal-use items with an item price of $150 or less are exempt from duty and VAT. List-clearance items shipped from the US are duty-free up to $200 under the Korea-US FTA rule. Import-declaration items such as supplements, medicine and electronics use $150 even from the US.

items.q: Does shipping count toward the limit?
items.a: Local sales tax and shipping within the origin country count; international shipping and insurance to Korea are excluded when clearly itemized. Once taxed, though, international shipping is added to the taxable value.

items.q: If I go slightly over, is only the excess taxed?
items.a: No. Over the limit, duty and VAT apply to the full customs value, item price plus international shipping, with no deduction. For example, $230 shoes from the US with $18 shipping are taxed on the full $248.

items.q: How are duty and VAT calculated?
items.a: Customs value = (item price + international shipping) × the customs taxation rate. Duty = customs value × the item's rate (13% clothing/shoes, 8% bags/cosmetics/watches, 0% laptops/phones, etc.), and VAT is 10% of customs value plus duty. Taxes under KRW 10,000 are not collected.

When items bought from the same overseas seller on the same day are imported separately, or one waybill is split into several clearances. Since November 17, 2022, different sellers or purchase dates are not combined even if they arrive the same day.

items.q: Can I get the duty back if I return the item?
items.a: Yes. If a personal-use item with an accepted import declaration is shipped back abroad unused within 6 months, the duty can be refunded (Customs Act Art. 106-2). A bonded-area or customs confirmation step is required, so contact customs before returning.

The weekly taxation rate set by the Korea Customs Service, an average of the previous week's base rates, so it can differ from your card rate. This calculator defaults to the market rate and lets you enter your own.

items.q: Do I need a Personal Customs Clearance Code?
items.a: Yes. It identifies the recipient instead of a resident registration number and is issued on UNI-PASS. From 2026 it is valid for one year and must be renewed within 30 days before or after expiry.
